Name: Berry Season Reminder
Author: GrendG
Description:
[b]Berry Season Reminder[/b] is a simple mod that adds icons to the calendar to remind you about berry season.  Never let it sneak up on you again!
This functionality is unlocked when you earn [i]Bear's Knowledge[/i]--thanks Mr. Bear!

[url=https://discord.gg/S5NQjbXPnb][img]https://i.imgur.com/Jig7El3.png[/img][/url]

[b]Problems, feature request, something else?  Join us on Discord![/b]

Downloads.Description: - Moved berry icon to the upper-right corner of calendar days to prevent icon overlaps.
